overview: The committee reviewed the draft city newsletter and finalized logistics and outreach strategies for the upcoming series of neighborhood ward meetings.

items.title: City Newsletter Review
items.summary: Chair Liz Mullane presented a draft newsletter covering budget highlights and public works updates, and the committee discussed methods for linking directly to final ordinance texts via MuniCode.

items.title: Newsletter Assignment Schedule
items.summary: Councilors established a rotating schedule for newsletter production through December, assigning specific months to individual members.

items.title: Neighborhood Ward Meetings Planning
items.summary: The committee coordinated the fall ward meeting schedule and discussed outreach strategies including social media, news publications, and paper flyers to ensure resident participation.

items.title: Noise Ordinance Update
items.summary: The committee briefly noted that the noise ordinance will be formally addressed during the next meeting in September.
